cause: An initial standalone focused probe was launched without per-probe APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA overrides. It writes real checkpoints even when ReefMain is constructed outside the normal boot.
impact: The default desktop profile was written during the probe. Prior contents/progress are unknown; no verified recent pre-test backup has been found. Do not infer that this profile was already a test save. The active owner preview uses its distinct custom MermaidReef-OperaRemovalReview-20261017 user directory, so that live preview profile was not the default target.
preservation: Default save, .bak and older before_new_game were copied unchanged to an ignored private task backup. No save bytes, private backup or save contents are committed. No blind restore was performed.
prevention: Focused probe now refuses ordinary default-user-data paths before constructing ReefMain.
All subsequent focused runs use fresh temporary APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA or XDG_DATA_HOME.
Capture helper asserts overrides under a fresh profile and records engine-reported actual user data directory.

negative_control.method: Simulated default profile inside a fresh disposable Temp directory, without touching real default data

acceptance_limit: This mitigation prevents recurrence; it does not recover unknown previous default-profile progress.
